direct_observations: Real PID/start/UID/FD snapshots and wait137, complete old persisted opt-in baselines, product attempt/retired log events, primary full sysfs plus atomically copied disk image with empty records before later pending API, all three HID/FTDI cycles and exact host sink.
Helper restart case observes same live owner/claims/records for at least5seconds under new helper, then recovery and new I/O after actual owner death.
source_constraints: The interval before primary makes only sysfs/proc/disk reads; absence of helper API is proven by frozen flow plus helper operation ordering, not system-wide syscall tracing.

Generated flow has no guest administrator bind/reconcile and no USBFS recovery test probe; attribution to helper CONNECT relies on frozen product implementation plus its runtime attempt/retired records and external restoration, not per-ioctl tracing.

limits: Two positive product QEMU scenarios, six total client I/O cycles, four guests. Check and polling counts are evidence assertions/samples, not USB cases.
ELF/initramfs originals were not retained; binary identities are recorded build/payload/after comparisons. This review does not rehash absent executable bytes or claim new software test execution.
Twenty-second recovery window begins after wait137 and coordination delivery, not at SIGKILL. Sample elapsed times are not a restoration latency SLA.

Same configuration1, one interface0/alt0 per HID/FTDI fixture only. No arbitrary cross-config/alt/composite/storage/hardware recovery, all-FD revocation, power-loss durability or external-root isolation conclusion.
Killed epoch has no final stopped/resource snapshot; no old zero-resource result is fabricated.
Other regression runs and CI are outside this report.

review_process.initial_result: 557/559 PASS; two fingerprint assertions failed because this independent parser originally sorted relative strings instead of pathlib path components.
review_process.correction: Changed only independent parser native/vendor fingerprint ordering to Path.parts ordering; no harness, product, original artifact, or runtime result changed. Frozen path sets and bytes were already exact.
